place.name: Alexandroupolis
place.description: Alexandroupolis (Ἀλεξανδρούπολις, IPA: [aleks̠anˈðɾupolis̠]) or Alexandroupoli (Αλεξανδρούπολη, IPA: [aleks̠anˈðɾupoli]), is a port city in Greece and the capital of the Evros regional unit, in Greek Thrace. It is the largest city in Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, with a population of 71,751 and is an important port and commercial center for Northern Greece.
